rationale: Shared: aligned-property regex census, g.F proxy validated on samples, varied-then-fixed factorial generators, proxy OLS ratios, true-logit flips on ambiguous cells, topic-constrained latent ranking, sample ablation. A decides from corpus OLS with topic by subtraction and runs minimal pairs on one probe, using a per-latent topic-leak filter. B decides from design OLS, runs two 2x2s across probes, uses a cumulative 20% topic cap and adds a true-vs-proxy slope/residual diagnostic.

Both flag an ambiguous-band property from proxy regression, then settle it with a true-logit property flip vs topic flip against a 0.3 ratio. A: candidates from both corpus-subtraction and design OLS, 8 texts testing two properties on two bases, per-latent 0.4x leak filter. B: design OLS only, one 4-text 2x2 on one template, greedy latents under a cumulative topic cap.
